segments.t: Feeling overwhelmed by her constant screen nudity, Sofia slips out of the premiere screening into the theater foyer. Gabriel joins her outside for an honest and comforting conversation. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Ah, je me sens plus libre ici!
Tu fumes une cigarette maintenant, Sofia?
Non, j'ai juste demandé cette cigarette.
Elle me fait tourner la tête.
Passe-moi la cigarette, s'il te plaît.
C'est vrai qu'elle est très forte!
Pardon d'être sortie de la salle.
Tu n'aimes pas le film de Julien?
Si, le film est très beau.
Mais je suis nue tout le temps!
C'est une expérience très difficile, Gabriel.
Tu es magnifique sur ce grand écran.
Le public adore ton immense talent!
Merci Gabriel, tu sais me rassurer.
Let's examine how Gabriel comforts Sofia step by step during the movie premiere.
Ah, je me sens plus libre ici!
'Ah, I feel more free here!' Sofia breathes easily after escaping the cinema hall.
Tu fumes une cigarette maintenant, Sofia?
'Are you smoking a cigarette now, Sofia?' Gabriel is surprised to find her holding a cigarette.
Non, j'ai juste demandé cette cigarette.
'No, I just asked for this cigarette.' Sofia explains she took one to calm her nerves.
Elle me fait tourner la tête.
'It makes my head spin.' Sofia admits the strong tobacco makes her dizzy.
Passe-moi la cigarette, s'il te plaît.
'Pass me the cigarette, please.' Gabriel takes the cigarette to help her relax.
C'est vrai qu'elle est très forte!
'It is true that it is very strong!' Gabriel confirms the tobacco's harsh strength with a cough.
Pardon d'être sortie de la salle.
'Sorry for having left the theater.' Sofia apologizes for stepping out during the premiere.
Tu n'aimes pas le film de Julien?
'Do you not like Julien's movie?' Gabriel wonders if she dislikes the artistic direction.
Si, le film est très beau.
'Yes, the movie is very beautiful.' Sofia affirms the aesthetic quality of the work.
Mais je suis nue tout le temps!
'But I am naked all the time!' Sofia confesses her deep embarrassment at her constant screen nudity.
C'est une expérience très difficile, Gabriel.
'It is a very difficult experience, Gabriel.' Sofia shares the vulnerability of exposing herself.
Tu es magnifique sur ce grand écran.
'You are magnificent on this big screen.' Gabriel reassures her of her poise and beauty.
Le public adore ton immense talent!
'The audience loves your immense talent!' Gabriel reminds her of the crowd's warm admiration.
Merci Gabriel, tu sais me rassurer.
'Thank you Gabriel, you know how to reassure me.' Sofia appreciates her agent's sensitive encouragement. Now let's listen to the scene once more from start to finish.

Gabriel reassures Sofia about her performance and body on screen, strengthening their deep bond of trust as actress and agent. Let's review the key expressions and vocabulary from this scene.
